newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli soldier wounded in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier wounded in south Lebanon.

text.p: An Israeli soldier was wounded in an attack by Moslem guerrillas in south Lebanon on Sunday, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The sources with the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia said Moslem guerrillas fired several rockets at an Israeli patrol on the road to Kassaret al-Oroush position inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
A Merkava tank was hit and a soldier was wounded, the sources said.
In Beirut, a spokesman for the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) said its guerrillas carried out the attack.
Hizbollah is fighting to oust 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 SLA militiamen from the 15-km (nine-miles)-deep south Lebanon zone.
